description: ESAS design-board hooks: puts the pending-edit count in front of a prompt while the user has unsynced board changes, and tells a session at t=0 to open the board's summon channel when a board is serving this repo and nobody is holding it. Both are inert in every repo without a .esas/ directory. Plus the lane git guard: in an unattended lane (.work/lane.yaml present) it blocks the git commands that discard or shelve the working tree, and is inert everywhere else.
